description: Use results where the driver started at a grid position numbered higher than 12. Average the per-driver point totals and the per-driver average laps.

d.request: For results with grid position > 12: compute each driver's total points and average laps completed, then report the mean total points across drivers and the mean average laps across drivers.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(total_points) as mean_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) as mean_average_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) subquery

a.request: Considering only race results where the starting grid position (`grid`) is higher than 12: for each driver, add up their points and average their laps completed (`laps`), ignoring missing values. Then, across all those drivers, what are the average points total and the average of their average laps, in one row and unrounded?
a.sql: SELECT AVG(driver_total_points) AS avg_points_total, AVG(driver_avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS driver_total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS driver_avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) AS driver_stats

c.request: For race results where the driver started from a grid position upwards of 12: add up each driver's points and average their laps completed (`laps`), ignoring missing values. Across those drivers, what are the average points total and the average of their average laps? Give one unrounded row. Use results where the driver started at a grid position numbered higher than 12. Average the per-driver point totals and the per-driver average laps.
c.sql: WITH filtered_results AS (SELECT driverId, points, laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12), driver_stats AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) as total_points, AVG(CASE WHEN laps IS NOT NULL AND laps != '' THEN CAST(laps AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_laps FROM filtered_results GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_points_total, AVG(avg_laps) as avg_of_avg_laps FROM driver_stats

b.request: For results where grid position > 12, calculate each driver's total points and mean laps, then report the average of all drivers' total points and the average of all drivers' mean laps.
b.sql: WITH driver_stats AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS FLOAT)) as mean_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points, AVG(mean_laps) as avg_mean_laps FROM driver_stats
b.raw: For results where grid position > 12, calculate each driver's total points and mean laps, then report the average of all drivers' total points and the average of all drivers' mean laps.
